content: The recommendations outlined in this guideline are based on specific digital interventions, each of which addresses the needs of health systems in unique yet interconnected ways. For health system managers, the recommendation regarding digital stock notification is designed to ensure the availability of medical commodities at the point of care delivery. From the perspective of clients and patients, these interventions aim to facilitate more immediate access to health information and services. This includes mechanisms such as telemedicine that enable direct communication between clients and providers, as well as targeted client communication strategies. Similarly, healthcare workers must remain accessible and adhere to evidence-based practices to deliver high-quality care. This can be achieved through interventions like decision support systems and mobile learning (mLearning) platforms, which enhance their ability to provide effective care. Figure 4 illustrates the connections between the various recommendations and demonstrates how these digital interventions collectively and cohesively address the diverse needs of health systems.
